title: Greenslots
description: Texture pack that makes craftable slots greener and easier to notice.
body:
Greenslots is a resource pack for Java that makes craftable slots greener in order to make craftable items more easy to identify on crafting tables.

was originally a personal texture pack but it seemed like others might want it

In order to access the Bedrock version, go to the link to our Google site. It should already be linked, but if you cant find it, I have placed it [here](https://sites.google.com/view/greenslots/home) just incase.
